_doc: Per-food NOVA processing-group corrections, keyed by USDA/national-table fdcId. Layered on top of the rule-based estimate in scripts/nova.mjs (override wins) and stamped into usda-foods.json by serializeFoods. Only foods whose name carries no marker the rules can see are listed here — national-table ferments and composite dishes (gnocchi), nutritional yeast (whose 'yeast' name reads as a leavening agent), prepared condiments, ready-to-serve broths, formulated plant-milk drink substitutes (whose rename to 'Milk, <plant>' strips the signal), and plant-based creams and yogurts (whose 'Cream'/'Yogurt' names read as dairy). NOVA assignment has low inter-rater agreement; these are estimates. Group: 1 minimally processed, 2 culinary ingredient, 3 processed, 4 ultra-processed.
